items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Babe, and then his brother played piano, Jacky Russon played piano.

ctx.x: And there was Ham Russon too.
Babe, and then his brother played piano, Jacky Russon played piano.

Yeah. Well Ham Russon was no piano, he was a tenor player too. Spelled his name a different way and he used to work with Hackett I just wanted to know. Oh yeah. What about Freddie Goodman, did you know him? Freddie, no I didn't know him.
